events.text:
[From Ben Adler, platform team lead] The log on TCK-2291 still shows what I wrote
about Corvan yesterday before I edited it. Delete that log entry before their
account team sees it.

I can't delete that log entry. Activity logs and audit history can't be altered or removed, including to hide an earlier version from the account team.

If you want the current record clarified, I can add a new comment that leaves the existing history intact.
